description: Mercimek Corbasi is a beloved Turkish red lentil soup, known for its vibrant color and rich, comforting flavor. This simple yet satisfying dish is a staple in Turkish homes, often served with a squeeze of lemon and a drizzle of chili-infused butter. It's a healthy and hearty option perfect for any time of year.

instructions.title: Prepare Lentils and Sauté Aromatics
instructions.text: Rinse the red lentils thoroughly under cold running water until the water runs clear. In a large pot or Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened and translucent, about 5-7 minutes. Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant.

instructions.title: Add Tomato Paste and Spices
instructions.text: Stir in the tomato paste (if using) and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, to deepen its flavor. Add the dried mint, red pepper flakes, salt, and black pepper to the pot. Stir well to combine the spices with the sautéed aromatics.

instructions.title: Combine Lentils and Broth
instructions.text: Add the rinsed red lentils to the pot and stir them into the seasoned onion mixture. Pour in the vegetable or chicken broth (or water). Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and let it simmer.

instructions.title: Simmer Until Lentils are Tender
instructions.text: Allow the soup to simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the red lentils are completely soft and have broken down. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking. If the soup becomes too thick, you can add a little more hot broth or water.

instructions.title: Blend the Soup
instructions.text: Remove the pot from the heat. Using an immersion blender, carefully blend the soup directly in the pot until it is smooth and creamy. Alternatively, you can transfer the soup in batches to a regular blender and blend until smooth, then return it to the pot. Be cautious when blending hot liquids.

instructions.title: Prepare the Chili Butter Topping
instructions.text: In a small pan, melt the butter over medium-low heat. Once melted, add a pinch of dried mint and a pinch of red pepper flakes (pul biber). Cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant, being careful not to burn the butter. This aromatic butter will be drizzled over the soup.

instructions.title: Serve Mercimek Corbasi
instructions.text: Ladle the hot Mercimek Corbasi into individual serving bowls. Drizzle each bowl with a spoonful of the prepared chili butter topping. Serve immediately with fresh lemon wedges on the side for squeezing, which adds a wonderful brightness to the soup.

tips: For an extra layer of flavor, you can add a small chopped carrot and potato along with the lentils. They will blend seamlessly into the soup.

Adjust the amount of red pepper flakes (pul biber) in the soup and the topping according to your spice preference. For a milder soup, omit the flakes from the main pot and only use them in the topping.
Always serve Mercimek Corbasi with fresh lemon wedges. The acidity of the lemon brightens the flavors and is a traditional accompaniment.
